To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) CloneCloud can automatically and seamlessly partition mobile applications to run on a cloud, achieving significant speedup and (2) CloneCloud can achieve different speedups for different inputs and different network conditions.

(i) CloneCloud can automatically partition and execute mobile applications in the cloud, achieving significant performance improvements and (ii) CloneCloud can adaptively adjust the partitioning of mobile applications based on different inputs, network conditions, and available resources.

CloneCloud can automatically partition applications into cloud-executable clones and seamlessly migrate them between the device and the cloud, thereby achieving substantial speedup and enabling new functionality on resource constrained mobile devices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: "How do you make mobile applications faster and more efficient by leveraging the cloud?"
the design and implementation issues of an application-level virtualization system that enables mobile devices to seamlessly and automatically benefit from computational clouds.
the design, implementation, and evaluation of a system that enables the seamless use of computational clouds by mobile applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CloneCloud provides a novel and efficient way to boost the execution of mobile applications through cloud clone execution.
CloneCloud can be used for boosting the performance of mobile applications by up to 21x, depending on the application and the available network bandwidth.
CloneCloud is a very useful system for mobile application developers and users.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CloneCloud can boost the performance of mobile device applications by up to 2.5x, on average.
CloneCloud is a system that can automatically transform unmodified mobile applications to benefit greatly from cloud clones.
CloneCloud is a system that enables mobile applications to seamlessly offload computation to the cloud and achieve significant speedups without any changes to the applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the computational cloud offers an opportunity to significantly improve mobile applications, and we hope that CloneCloud serves as a stepping stone to further research in this space.
mobile applications can benefit greatly from offloading part of their execution to computational clouds.
the combination of static and dynamic analysis can enable automatic application transformation to exploit cloud resources.
